name: Moon
summary: Earth's only natural satellite, probably formed from a giant impact ~4.5 billion years ago; it stabilises Earth's tilt and drives tides.
sound_desc: The Moon has no air, so it is silent. Apollo astronauts heard sounds only through their suits and spacecraft; Apollo 10's crew reported eerie 'music' on the far side, later explained as radio interference.

name: Phobos
summary: A potato-shaped moon spiralling inward; it will break apart or crash into Mars in ~50 million years.
sound_desc: Space is a near-perfect vacuum, so no sound travels through it. This moon has no thick atmosphere, so no sound has been recorded.
